\begin{example} \end{example}[Bryant soliton] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0104, page-0105 1. ch19:19.12\group Examples

The rotationally symmetric steady gradient soliton on $\mathbb R^n$ has $g_{\rm Bry}=dr^2+w(r)^2g_{S^{n-1}}$, with \[ f''=n\frac{w''}{w},\qquad ww'f'=ww''-(n-1)(1-(w')^2), \] and $w'(r)\le Cr^{-1/2}$, $C^{-1}r^{1/2}\le w(r)\le Cr^{1/2}$. Rescaled far-out annuli are $\varepsilon $-necks; higher derivative estimates upgrade the $C^0$ necks to embedded smooth necks. \end{example}
